gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-geist: Words in Geist come out as solid blocks, quiet and level, with no flicker of heavy accents. Geist is a plain sans that lets Delius Unicase's rope-ladder spacing and relaxed handwriting be the one thing you remember.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-georama: Georama reads as friendly and unfussy, its wide-open c like a bracelet pulled apart and its capitals barely rising. And over a full page its plain sans shapes stay inviting, while Delius Unicase keeps its marker-like strokes up top.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-gidole:
Delius Unicase writes like a marker, every stroke blunt and untapered.

Gidole's neon-tube consistency and scissor-blade openings keep that handwritten looseness from drifting, and the whole pairing feels tidy but relaxed.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-glegoo: Loose marker lettering meets editorial polish here. Delius Unicase is best at a friendly, tall-x-height hello, and Glegoo, a classic serif with wide, unclosed curves, is best at carrying refined text.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-golos-text: Delius Unicase brings an easy, handwritten warmth, with strokes that never taper and a tall x-height. Golos Text follows in a plain sans of uniform stroke, its widely parted s keeping the line open.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-graduate:
Marker-pen casual meets old-school dignity.

Delius Unicase's untapered strokes feel relaxed next to Graduate, a classic serif with generous letter spacing and capitals that sit nearly level with its lowercase, and the difference is the charm.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-hanuman: Hanuman reads traditional and refined, its high-waisted lowercase carrying wide-set terminals on the s. Across a long passage it stays dignified and unhurried, while Delius Unicase's marker-like constant line adds a looser, friendlier voice above.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-hedvig-letters-: Relaxed and inviting from the first word, Delius Unicase writes in strokes with no thin or thick swings, like a marker. Hedvig Letters Sans does the quieter job, with small letters nearly as tall as capitals.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-heebo: Relaxed, handwritten and friendly, Delius Unicase draws bowls and stems at one weight. Heebo does the steadier work, with a tall central band and curves that stop short rather than closing in.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-hind-guntur:
Delius Unicase is handwritten, relaxed and plainly friendly.

Hind Guntur's tall, stamped-metal lowercase and wide gaps at its curve ends read cleanly, so give the sans a comfortable size and let the heading stay as it is.
